title: Movistar Signs Spanish Star Paula Blasi in Blockbuster €1.8 Million Deal
content:
MARCA reports that Blasi will earn 600,000 euros per season in three-year deal with Movistar, making her one of women's cycling's highest-paid riders.

Read the full article at Movistar Signs Spanish Star Paula Blasi in Blockbuster €1.8 Million Deal on Velo.
author: ahood
